raw.title: Senior Backend Developer
raw.description:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

  • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

  • The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

  • Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

  • The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

  • The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work

We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year

In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

Who we are looking for

  • You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.

  • You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.

  • You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

  • You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.

  • You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.

  • You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

  • You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

  • English is your working language. German is a plus.

What makes you stand out

  • You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

  • You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

  • You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

  • You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

The team

We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.

We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.

The facts

  • Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team

  • Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership

  • Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers

  • Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith

  • Pensum: 100%

  • Start: As soon as possible

  • Language: English; German a plus

  • Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls

How to apply

Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does.

Deine Perspektiven: Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem jungen Team Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege Spannende und vielseitige Aufgaben, die viel Eigeninitiative erfordern Regelmäßige Feedback Gespräche und transparente Kommunikation Zukunftsorientierte Tätigkeit in einem innovativen Unternehmen Unsere Benefits: Zukunftssicherheit mit Extras Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und baue dir entspannt deine finanzielle Absicherung auf – wir unterstützen dich dabei mit einem monatlichen Zuschuss. Familienfreundlichkeit im Fokus Wir entlasten dich bei den Betreuungskosten durch einen monatlichen Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung – damit Familie und Beruf gut zusammenpassen. Flexibilität durch digitale Benefits Ob Shopping, Tanken oder Freizeitaktivitäten – du erhältst ein monatliches Guthaben, das du ganz nach deinen Wünschen einsetzen kannst. Alternativ kannst du mit Wellpass deutschlandweit auf über 8.000 Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote zugreifen – online oder vor Ort – und profitierst dabei von unserem attraktiven Firmenrabatt. Fitness direkt im Haus Kein Zeitverlust – nutze unser hauseigenes Gym , um dich vor, während oder nach der Arbeit fit zu halten. Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte Sichere dir exklusive Vergünstigungen auf unsere Marken – mit satten Rabatten auf Produkte von TEVEO, fayn. und Meek & Hon. Kostenloses Laden von E-Autos An unserem Standort in Ansbach kannst du dein E-Fahrzeug bequem und kostenlos laden – nachhaltig und praktisch. Selbstverständlich ist für uns: Wasser, Kaffee und verschiedene Milchsorten in unseren Offices in Hamburg und Ansbach. Onboarding vor Ort: In den ersten zwei Monaten ermöglichen wir dir unser Team, unsere Arbeitsweise und unsere Kultur persönlich kennenzulernen – so legen wir gemeinsam die Basis für die Zusammenarbeit in der Zukunft. Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Aufträgen, kurzfristigen Änderungen und unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern den Überblick. Du erkennst frühzeitig, wenn etwas nicht rundläuft, findest pragmatische Lösungen und packst bei Bedarf selbst mit an. Du beantwortest Anfragen, berätst zu unseren Dienstleistungen, koordinierst Termine und findest Lösungen für individuelle Anliegen. Du kommunizierst freundlich, offen und professionell und sorgst dafür, dass sich unsere Kunden jederzeit gut betreut fühlen. Du begleitest Interessenten und Neukunden vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Buchung. Das bringen Du mit Must-have Organisationstalent: Du liebst es, Dinge zu strukturieren, zu koordinieren und den Überblick zu behalten – auch wenn zehn Dinge gleichzeitig passieren. Ein modernes, digitales Arbeitsumfeld: Wir setzen auf smarte Tools, effiziente Prozesse und neue Technologien statt auf unnötige Bürokratie. Ein freundliches, motiviertes Team: Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, kommunizieren auf Augenhöhe und ziehen gemeinsam an einem Strang. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung: Kurze Wege, ehrliche Kommunikation und schnelle Entscheidungen. Gestaltungsspielraum: Deine Ideen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Wenn Du einen besseren Weg findest, möchten wir davon hören. Unser Geschäftsbüro in Leverkusen steht Dir jederzeit als alternativer Arbeitsplatz und für persönliche Treffen mit dem Team zur Verfügung. Vertrauen statt Kontrolle: Wir setzen auf ein sehr hohes Maß an gegenseitigem Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und selbstständigem Arbeiten. Flexibilität für Kundentermine: Während Deiner Arbeitszeiten solltest Du bereit sein, bei Bedarf auch persönlich zu Kundenterminen zu fahren. Dafür bist Du mobil und kannst Termine eigenständig wahrnehmen. Faire, entwicklungsgerechte Vergütung: Mit wachsender Erfahrung und Verantwortung kann sich auch Deine Vergütung weiterentwickeln. Intensive Einarbeitung: Wir nehmen uns die Zeit, Dich mit unseren Dienstleistungen, Systemen und Prozessen vertraut zu machen. Passt Du zu uns? Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur seine To-do-Liste abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und Freude daran hat, Dinge am Laufen zu halten. Jemanden, der auch dann den Überblick behält, wenn es mal hektisch wird. Der gerne mit Menschen spricht, technisch fit ist, eigenständig Lösungen findet und sich nicht davor scheut, Fehler zu machen und daraus zu lernen. Buchhaltung ist für die meisten Gründerinnen und Gründer ein Blackbox-Posten: teuer, langsam, und am Ende weiß niemand genau, wofür er zahlt.
mika ändert das. Wir bauen KI-gestützte Buchhaltung, die Unternehmen selbst in die Hand nehmen können, ohne Steuerberater dazwischen. Belegerfassung, Klassifizierung, E-Rechnung, Validierung und Meldungen laufen automatisiert, statt im Monatsrhythmus über einen externen Schreibtisch zu wandern.
Wir sind 30 Personen, betreuen rund 900 Kunden und haben unsere Seed-Runde frisch abgeschlossen.

Worum es geht
Unsere CEO und Mitgründerin hat auf LinkedIn eine starke Personal Brand aufgebaut. Sie spricht auf Bühnen, co-hostet einen Podcast und ist eine der lauteren Stimmen zu Unternehmertum und KI. Jetzt soll das auch auf Instagram, TikTok und ggf. YouTube funktionieren, und zwar so, wie es auf diesen Kanälen funktioniert, nicht als Kopie von LinkedIn. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du produzierst Video- und Visual-Content für die Kanäle unserer CEO: Short-Form-Videos, Podcast-Schnipsel, Visuals

  • Du begleitest sie auf Veranstaltungen und machst dort Content: Talks, Backstage, Gespräche, Stimmung

  • Du baust ihre Kanäle auf Instagram, TikTok und ggf. YouTube aus, mit einer eigenen Logik für jeden Kanal

  • Du entscheidest mit, welche Inhalte über die CEO laufen und welche über mika

  • Du filmst, schneidest und schreibst selbst, von der Idee bis zum fertigen Post

  • Du beobachtest Trends und reagierst schnell darauf, nicht erst drei Wochen später

  • Du produzierst auf Deutsch und auf Englisch

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast schon Kanäle aufgebaut, idealerweise für dich selbst oder für eine Gründerin oder einen Gründer, und kannst das mit Zahlen und Beispielen zeigen

  • Du weißt, warum ein Video auf TikTok anders funktioniert als auf Instagram oder YouTube, und baust Content entsprechend

  • Du filmst und schneidest sicher, mit dem Handy genauso wie mit der Kamera

  • Du schreibst gut, auf Deutsch und auf Englisch (min C1)

  • Du bist schnell, arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst keine Briefings für jeden Post

  • Du wohnst in Berlin oder ziehst her, denn ohne Präsenz vor Ort geht der Job nicht

  • Du reist gern und bist 1–4 Mal im Monat auf Events in Deutschland dabei

Was dich erwartet

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit der CEO und hast echten Einfluss darauf, wie sie und mika nach außen wirken

  • Du baust etwas auf: Du übernimmst keinen fertigen Redaktionsplan, du entwickelst die Kanäle selbst

  • Du bist auf Bühnen, Events und hinter den Kulissen eines schnell wachsenden KI-Startups dabei

  • Du hast viel Freiraum bei Formaten und Ideen, solange sie funktionieren

Bewerbung
Schick uns statt eines langen Anschreibens 3–5 Links zu Kanälen oder Videos, die du aufgebaut oder produziert hast, und schreib in zwei Sätzen dazu, was deine Rolle dabei war.

Bei mika schätzen wir Vielfalt und arbeiten an einem Umfeld, in dem alle im Team ihr Bestes geben können. Bau mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen für kleine Unternehmen.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling.

As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.

This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition.
  • Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity.
  • Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer.
  • Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders.
  • Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.
  • Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome.
  • Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close.
  • Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload.
  • Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance.
  • Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses.
  • Travel within the assigned territory as required. 

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus.
  • Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline.
  • Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners.
  • Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.
  • Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open-source software.
  • Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal-management skills.
  • Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences.
  • Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills.
  • B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field.
  • Experience with Fortune 500 or security-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open-source or consumption-based products, or emerging categories is preferred.

SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.

title: Senior BI Analyst - THG Beauty
description:
About THG 

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF

Life at THG Beauty 

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.

By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.

THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader. 

Why be a Senior BI Analyst at THG Beauty? 

As Senior BI Analyst for Beauty, you will own the reporting layer that enables the Beauty Data & Insight team and senior Beauty leadership to understand and act on business performance. You will build and maintain trusted dashboards and reports — covering customer, commercial and operational performance — ensuring that the metrics leadership relies on are accurate, consistent and drive decisions. You will work closely with the Beauty analytics team, the Reporting Lead and the Engineering team.  

What You'll Do:

Reporting & Dashboard Development 

  • Own and maintain the Beauty reporting suite — dashboards covering customer performance, trading, commercial analytics and operational KPIs 
  • Build new reports and dashboards to support evolving business requirements 
  • Ensure all Beauty reporting meets the metric standards set by the Reporting Lead — consistent definitions, clear labelling, reliable data 
  • Work with the Reporting Lead to rationalise and improve the reporting estate 

Data & Analytics 

  • Write and maintain SQL queries to support reporting and ad hoc analytical requests 
  • Validate data — working with engineering teams to identify and resolve discrepancies 
  • Support the Beauty analytics team with data and reporting needs 

Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Work with Beauty stakeholders — including the Head of Beauty and analytics leads — to understand reporting requirements 
  • Communicate clearly about what the data shows, what it doesn't show, and why 
  • Manage requests effectively — setting expectations and delivering reliably 

 THG Career Framework — What Good Looks Like at This Level 

  • Deep expertise in BI and reporting — the go-to person for Beauty reporting and metric questions 
  • Interprets and explains data concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders 
  • Coaches junior analysts on BI best practice and data quality 
  • Accountable for own targets — delivers to a high standard with minimal supervision 
  • Understands how reporting quality links to business decision-making quality 
  • Makes pragmatic decisions on reporting priorities — balancing stakeholder requests with data quality 

What We're Looking For:

Essential 

  • Experience (typically 3+ years) in BI, reporting or analytics roles 
  • Hands-on experience with Tableau or equivalent BI tooling — able to build production-quality dashboards 
  • Strong SQL skills — comfortable building complex queries and validating data 
  • Experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer goods reporting 
  • Attention to detail — committed to the accuracy and consistency of what you produce 

Desirable 

  • Experience with GCP and BigQuery or equivalent cloud data platform 
  • Exposure to beauty, wellness or lifestyle brand data environments 
  • Familiarity with data governance concepts as applied to reporting 
  • Experience in customer, commercial or operational analytics domains 

What’s in it for me? 

Career Development 

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider. 

Enhanced Leave 

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays. 
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us! 
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.  
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave. 
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year. 
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months. 

Wellbeing Support 

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
  • Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.  
  • State-of-the-art on-site gym. 
  • Access to our on-site physio. 

Other Perks 

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme. 
  • Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.  
  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands. 
  • On-site staff shop.
  • Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation. 
  • Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service. 

THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our Talent team to discuss further.

title: Software QA Engineer II
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Axon’s RF sensors detect and locate drones so public safety and critical infrastructure teams can protect airspace. You will own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor capabilities — spanning regression, integration, and real-world validation — so those systems are trustworthy in the lab and in the field. You will work closely with RF Engineering at the intersection of software, hardware, and real-world RF, helping turn technical evidence into confident product decisions.

Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel, Germany office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor software from design through release, adding rigor through regression, integration, and real-world validation.
  • Design and own test strategies spanning feature, regression, integration / interface, system, and field validation. Combine automated coverage with targeted manual validation based on risk and technical feasibility.
  • Develop in-depth functional tests for individual components of the RF sensor software, and keep those tests maintainable as the product evolves.
  • Reproduce, isolate, and characterize issues on real sensor hardware and in test environments; capture clear reproduction steps, logs, and environment details.
  • Build and maintain hardware-backed automated regression tests and supporting test tooling.
  • Monitor and improve development and test systems and test hardware so environments stay stable, observable, and ready for daily use.
  • Partner closely with RF Engineering and independently verify behavior in realistic environments and across system interfaces. Execute system, release, field, and acceptance testing with release stakeholders.
  • Document test results and defects clearly, and contribute to software design reviews and after-action reviews for the work you own.
  • Share knowledge with the wider team, give actionable feedback, and support newer engineers and interns through pairing, reviews, and onboarding.
  • Use approved agentic AI tools regularly to design tests, analyze results, and draft documentation and review AI output against quality, security, and performance standards before you rely on it.

 

What You Bring

  • A degree or vocational qualification in electrical engineering, computer science, embedded systems, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience testing software that runs on or with hardware (embedded products, devices, sensors, or similar systems), including independently owning the test and quality approach for that work.
  • Experience with RF, embedded, sensor, or similarly hardware-integrated systems, with the technical aptitude and curiosity to develop deep expertise in RF sensor technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests or test tooling, ideally in Python pytest, with the ability to independently support hardware-backed regression testing.
  • Comfort working in Linux-based systems (SSH, Networking).
  • A collaborative, quality-focused working style: you Join Forces with others, Own It on the quality of the work you take on, and speak up with candor when something is unclear or broken.
  • It’s a plus if you have experience with drones or hardware-in-the-loop / continuous integration test setups and an interest in supporting others as they grow.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

.

Hiring and how we work

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join us as our next Senior Solutions Engineer on Twilio’s Digital Sales Communications team!

About the job

This position is needed to enable our customers to build the future of communications. The Senior Solutions Engineer is a critical part of the sales team focused on our Digital Sales segment.

Location

This role will be remote AND based in the United Kingdom. 

Travel

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio. We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience. Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance. Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis. Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension. Own delivery end to end - set the roadmap, own the backlog, and take each bet from discovery to launch with engineering, design and data: frame the problem, write the specs and user stories, prioritise sprint by sprint, make the scope calls, and measure what shipped. This is a hands-on build role, not a coordination role. Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet. Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction. Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform. Your Profile: 5+ years in product management , including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup. A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit. Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features. Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring. Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them. Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level. Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders. A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus. Fluent English required Our hiring process : TA Call : Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better. Technical Round : Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case) , and meet your potential manager. Final Round : Meet other Atollians 🏝️ It varies from 1 to 3 interviews *Some processes might slightly change according to needs Ready to apply? Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. raw.description:
About Edra

Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations.

We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. We're a deeply technical team of engineers, AI researchers, and strategists with a high bar for talent and a shared belief that exceptional people are the foundation of everything great we'll build.


The Role

We're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join our infrastructure team as the second-in-seat hire. Our team ships fast enough that we're starting to hit GitHub's rate limits, and infrastructure has to stay a month ahead of that. You'll be in key engineering meetings to ensure our infrastructure is ready before anyone asks, and to catch any decisions that may become infrastructure problems later.

This is not a ticket queue. You'll decide what gets built, push back when a managed service already does what someone wants to hand-roll, and invent when no pattern exists. You'll also write real software, not just the infrastructure code underneath it. We run containerized workloads on AWS and GCP, defined in infrastructure as code, with Postgres underneath. Some of our early infrastructure was built quickly before anyone owned it full-time. Part of the job is untangling that while keeping the team moving.


What You'll Do

  • Own our cloud infrastructure end to end: provisioning, security, reliability, and the infrastructure as code that defines it.

  • Stay ahead of the engineering roadmap and have infrastructure ready before features land, working directly with the founders on where the infrastructure goes next

  • Find where developers are waiting and remove the wait, whether that's CI, deployment, or environment spin-up. A person sat waiting is the most expensive thing we run, so rational spend on velocity is always on the table

  • Run the reliability practice: monitoring, logging, and alerting that fails loudly with a clear signal, and the response when it does

  • Lead large infrastructure builds and own our product security posture

  • Make the build-vs-managed-service call, and hold the line when the simpler path is the right one

  • Read and write Python well enough to see the infrastructure implications of what the team's building and catch problems before they land

  • Own AI model safety and the governance of agentic processes. The team leans on agents for repetitive work, and you make sure nothing unsupervised can act on production infrastructure

  • Hand capability to others, and support the team cross-functionally: build the tooling that lets engineers, GTM, the AI team, operations, and compliance do without you what today requires you

  • Keep current across cloud and model providers so that when an engineer brings a new announcement, you have a credible answer


What We’re Looking For

description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Role The AIT Systems Integration Engineer owns functional and system-level testing of our spacecraft and the verification tracking for each satellite campaign. Working within the Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT) team, you will take the satellite from integrated subsystems to a flight-ready, fully verified vehicle. You will bridge systems engineering, subsystem teams and the AIT Engineering Functions. You will turn requirements into test procedures, run and lead test campaigns, and make sure every requirement is closed out with traceable evidence before launch. The role suits someone who knows SmallSat development approaches, is hands-on with Hardware and Ground Support Equipment (GSE), and understands how satellite subsystems behave together. Responsibilities Functional and system testing Own the functional and system test programme for the spacecraft, from unit-level acceptance, integration, thought to whole System End-to-End Testing. Write, review and run test specifications and procedures, including basic functional testing, FDIR, end-to-end tests and mission/day-in-the-life simulations. Lead test readiness reviews and test review boards, and sign off test reports. Run tests before, during and after environmental campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum, EMC) to confirm spacecraft health. Diagnose anomalies, raise and track Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and drive root-cause investigations with subsystem engineers. Develop and maintain automated test scripts and telemetry/telecommand (TM/TC) databases used for testing. Verification tracking Own the verification matrix (VCRM) for the satellite campaign, mapping each requirement to its method: test, analysis, inspection or review of design. Plan the verification approach with Systems Engineering and keep it current through the campaign. Collect and link verification evidence, and report close-out status against milestones. Prepare verification data packages for key reviews (e.g. CDR, TRR, QR, PSR/FAR) and customer acceptance. GSE and test infrastructure Specify, integrate and validate Electrical GSE, including power supplies, battery simulators, RF test sets, umbilicals and break-out boxes. Maintain the spacecraft checkout software and ground segment interfaces used on the AIT floor. Make sure GSE is calibrated, configuration-controlled and safe for use with flight hardware. Integration and campaign support Support subsystem and payload integration, including electrical interface checks, harness verification and safe-to-mate procedures. Plan and schedule system test activities within the wider AIT campaign. Support launch campaign activities, including transport, launch site checkout and launch vehicle interface testing. Work to cleanroom, ESD and flight hardware handling standards, and contribute to lessons learned for future missions. Requirements Degree in Aerospace, Electronic, Electrical or Systems Engineering, Physics, or equivalent experience. Typically 3+ years in spacecraft AIT, systems integration or test engineering. Hands-on experience with functional and system-level testing of satellites or space subsystems. Familiarity with SmallSat development approaches: agile, rapid iteration, protoflight models, and pragmatic use of COTS components. Working knowledge of satellite subsystems: EPS, OBC/C&DH, ADCS, communications (TT&C and payload RF), propulsion, thermal, structures and payloads. Experience using and setting up GSE, including EGSE, checkout systems and RF test equipment. Experience with requirements verification and maintaining a verification matrix through to close-out. Comfortable with lab equipment: oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters, spectrum analysers, logic analysers. Familiarity with common spacecraft interfaces and protocols (e.g. CAN, I2C, SPI, RS-422, SpaceWire, CCSDS). Clear technical writing for procedures, test reports and NCRs. Desirables End-to-end involvement in at least one satellite mission that reached launch. Test automation and scripting in Python or similar, and experience with spacecraft control or checkout software (e.g. OpenC3/COSMOS, Yamcs, SCOS-2000). Experience planning or supporting environmental test campaigns (vibration, TVAC, EMC). Knowledge of ECSS standards (e.g. ECSS-E-ST-10-02 Verification, ECSS-E-ST-10-03 Testing) or NASA equivalents. Requirements management tools (e.g. DOORS, Jama, Polarion, Valispace). Launch campaign experience at a launch site. Cleanroom and ESD-certified flight hardware handling. Eligibility for UK security clearance, or the ability to obtain it, if required by the programme. Personal attributes Takes ownership: drives tests and verification to close-out without waiting to be asked. Methodical and detail-focused, with a strong sense of safety and quality around flight hardware. Calm, structured problem-solver when anomalies appear under schedule pressure. Communicates clearly across disciplines, from subsystem engineers to programme managers and customers. Comfortable in a fast-paced SmallSat environment, balancing rigour with pace. Willing to work flexibly during test and launch campaigns, including occasional travel. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO. Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups. Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week. raw.title: Deployment Strategist, Public Sector (EMEA)
raw.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As an EMEA Public Sector Deployment Strategist, you will own the post-sale experience for a portfolio of public sector customers across the region, including law enforcement agencies, regulators, and government teams working some of the most complex cases in crypto-related crime. You will own onboarding, adoption, outcomes and the relationship across all TRM products, including Ardence, our newest and fastest-moving product. Your mandate is not just to manage accounts. You will define what success looks like for each customer, prove it with usage and outcomes, and enable the renewals and expansion that follow alongside our Account Directors.

The impact you will have:

  • Onboard and activate your EMEA Public Sector accounts across all TRM products, with a clear onboarding path and measurable hands-on-keyboard usage for every account in your portfolio

  • Use AI to build production CS workflows that pull from ChurnZero, Salesforce, Gong, and product usage telemetry to auto-generate account health summaries and QBR drafts — compressing hours of reporting prep into minutes so you can spend your time on the work that actually requires human judgment

  • Define and track adoption benchmarks across the portfolio — hands-on-keyboard usage, consumption rates, and account-specific success metrics — and surface at-risk accounts before renewal decisions are made

  • Develop new use cases with investigators and analysts that deepen usage across TRM products, including Ardence, and feed what you learn back into onboarding and enablement for the wider team

  • Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at public sector agencies and regulators across EMEA — building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner

  • Partner with ADs, who own the commercial motion, to enable renewals and expansion: bring account health, adoption evidence, and a structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract, and take accountability for the GRR and NRR outcomes that adoption drives

  • Close the feedback loop between customers and Product — synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap

  • Work as one team with EMEA colleagues across languages and time zones, sharing the playbooks, workflows, and account plans that work so coverage is consistent across the region

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years in customer success, deployment, or post-sale roles with proven accountability for GRR, NRR, and adoption outcomes — you have the track record, not just the title

  • Domain credibility in law enforcement, public sector, cyber, national security, financial crime, or blockchain intelligence — you can walk into a room of investigators and earn their trust in the first meeting, not the fifth

  • Comfort with ambiguity — you have worked in fast-changing product environments, can ship a working v1 without waiting for a perfect playbook, and can point to the specific outcomes it drove; Ardence is still evolving and your accounts may shift as it matures

  • Production AI fluency — you have built real, repeatable AI workflows (not just experiments) that synthesize data from multiple sources into outputs that run consistently and have measurable results; you can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop

  • High level of independence — you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers

  • Strong executive presence — you can run a QBR with a senior government or public sector stakeholder and command the room through substance, not just polish

  • Based in the UK or Europe and comfortable working with customers across EMEA; additional European languages are a plus

About the Team:

  • The EMEA Public Sector team supports law enforcement, government, and regulatory customers working on complex cases involving crypto-related financial crime, cyber threats, and national security risks

  • You will join the EMEA Deployment Strategy team, which covers the region by geography and language (DACH and Eastern Europe, the UK, and SPLATAM), alongside Customer Experience. This is a net-new seat that adds coverage across our accounts, with high autonomy and meaningful influence on how we serve the region

  • The broader TRM CS organization operates distributed, not distant — async-first communication through Slack, strong documentation, and intentional synchronous time for key decisions

  • You will work directly with the Head of EMEA Deployment Strategy and the Head of Customer Success, with close day-to-day collaboration with the AD team and Product

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • As a globally distributed team, members may observe different timezones. However, most of the team will overlap between the hours of 7am-5:00 pm PST for meetings and collaboration.

  • Our Customer success Team is fully remote, thriving on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation. We hold weekly Customer Syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with our customers. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team.

  • Moves fast and iterates — v1 ships before it is perfect, and feedback is expected to be direct and specific

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Ownership: While there is no formal hourly rotation, you will be the primary lead for your area and responsible for customer success. This requires a high degree of agency and a commitment to seeing mission-critical tasks through to resolution, including the flexibility to handle urgent needs outside of standard hours or on weekends when they arise.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 30 days of joining, you have met every account in your portfolio and shipped a working onboarding and adoption plan for your first 2–3 accounts — not a slide deck, but a live document with measurable adoption benchmarks that the account team is already using to set customer expectations

  • Within 6 weeks, you share a draft success metrics framework at 50% complete with the account team and key customers to validate direction — getting real signal on what drives credit consumption before investing further in building out the full playbook

  • Within 60 days, you identify the highest-impact use case or adoption play for your portfolio — presenting a concrete recommendation to leadership on what to prioritize and why, grounded in actual account data

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

description: 🌀 The Company Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. You'll help keep our open source and enterprise products trustworthy for the 6,000+ organizations that defend themselves with them. This is not a solo audit role. As a Staff engineer, you advise the CISO on product security and turn their strategy into day-to-day practice in the product teams. You lead security as a cross-cutting concern, and coach engineers so they own security in their own scope. And of course, you still code: critical security fixes, PR reviews, pair programming and the shared security components that make the secure path the easy one. 💼 Your Responsibilities Leverage AI tools and methodologies to boost productivity and impact Contribute to building AI capabilities into internal workflows Advise the CISO on product security strategy across the XTM platform, and lead its operational implementation in the product teams: turn priorities into concrete actions, and track security technical pains to resolution. raw.description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

raw.title: Product Manager Energy Markets & Flexibility (m/f/d)
raw.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective.

By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Your mission

  • Conceptualization & Expansion of Energy Market Solutions: Development and operational establishment of scalable models for balancing group management (BKM), direct marketing, and flexibility optimization for our C&I and enterprise customers with multi-site portfolios
  • Tech & Market interface: Close collaboration with our software and product teams to further develop our virtual power plant (Heartbeat AI Enterprise) – defining functional requirements for aggregation, dynamic flexibility bands, and schedule setpoints
  • Partner & Trading Management: Selection, integration, and ongoing management of external BKM and trading partners (e.g., algorithmic intraday trading companies, aggregators, transmission system operators)
  • Multi-Use Operating Models: Design of prioritization and operational logic for commercial battery storage systems (e.g., balancing UPS/backup priority, grid-charge-optimized peak shaving, and spot market arbitrage)
  • Risk & Schedule Management: Monitoring forecasting quality, balancing energy costs (reBAP), and schedule notifications to minimize financial risks in the balancing group
  • Regulatory Framing: Ensuring and implementing relevant energy industry regulations (e.g., mixed storage guidelines / MiSpeL, MaBiS, Redispatch 2.0) in customer contracts and system workflows
  • Sales Support: Support during enterprise customer pitches, creation of economic models, and design of revenue-sharing concepts (profit-split)

Your profile

  • Completed degree in energy economics, industrial engineering, electrical engineering, business administration, or a comparable qualification
  • Several years of professional experience in balancing group management (BKM), at a direct marketer, flexibility aggregator (VPP), or in short-term power trading (EPEX SPOT Day-Ahead / Intraday)
  • Sound understanding of the deployment and monetization of large-scale and commercial battery energy storage systems (BESS) as well as PV systems in the C&I segment
  • Solid knowledge of the German regulatory framework (StromNEV, EnWG, MaBiS, MiSpeL) and market communication processes
  • High affinity for software, IoT architectures, and API-driven data flows between edge gateways, VPP platforms, and trading systems
  • Strong analytical mindset, entrepreneurial drive, and structured problem-solving skills
  • Persuasive communicator at eye level with enterprise customers and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork
  • Business fluent in German and English, both spoken and written

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

title: AI Software Builder (m/w/d)
description: AI Software Builder (m/w/d) Code schreiben. KI zähmen. Eine Branche aufs nächste Level bringen. 📍 Remote First – deutschlandweit | 2–3 Tage im Monat in Sinsheim 💰 36.000–42.000 € brutto/Jahr 💻 Vollzeit | Unbefristet Die Immobilienbranche ist digital noch nicht da, wo sie sein könnte. Das ändern wir gerade mit unserem eigenen ERP, gebaut mit KI. In unserer Party ist nur noch der Slot „Entwickler“ frei. Das ist deine Stelle, wenn … – du an einem Bug dranbleibst, bis er wirklich gelöst ist, – du mit Claude, Cursor & Co. nicht nur chattest, sondern damit baust, – du Strategiespiele magst, weil man da erst denkt und dann klickt, – dein GitHub mehr über dich verrät als dein Lebenslauf, – du ein Problem lieber selbst knackst, als auf ein Ticket zu warten. Studium abgeschlossen, abgebrochen oder nie angefangen? Ausbildung, Quereinstieg, Autodidakt? Ist uns egal. Wir schauen darauf, was du baust. Wer wir sind Wir sind die Zapf Unternehmensgruppe, ein Mittelständler mit Schwerpunkt Immobilien, Projektentwicklung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle. Unter der ImmoSandbox GmbH entwickeln wir LeaseFox, ein ERP für die Verwaltung und Bewirtschaftung von Gewerbeimmobilien. Ideen für KI-Anwendungen, Automatisierungen und digitale Werkzeuge haben wir reichlich, sie entstehen bei uns schneller, als man „Feature-Request“ sagen kann. Was uns fehlt, ist jemand, der daraus saubere, stabile Software macht und dabei mitdenkt, wohin die Reise geht. Deine Quests – LeaseFox weiterbauen: neue Features, Bugs jagen, Architektur aufräumen. – Mit KI entwickeln: Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot sind für dich Werkzeuge und keine Spielerei. Du weißt, wann du der KI trauen kannst und wann nicht. – Automatisieren: Muss etwas zum dritten Mal von Hand erledigt werden, schreibst du ein Skript dafür. – Prototypen bauen: Du testest neue Ideen schnell und zeigst, was technisch geht. – Ordnung ins kreative Chaos bringen: Du machst aus schnellen Ideen wartbaren Code, mit Struktur, Tests und Doku. – Mitdenken: Du bringst eigene Ideen mit, statt nur Aufgaben abzuarbeiten. – Auch Grinding gehört dazu: Support-Anfragen unserer LeaseFox-Nutzer, Bugfixes, Pflege. Ohne das kein Level-up. Dein Skilltree – erste echte Projekte in Python, JavaScript oder TypeScript – Grundverständnis davon, wie Anwendungen, Datenbanken und APIs zusammenspielen – KI-Tools, mit denen du selbst schon etwas gebaut hast – logisches Denken und Durchhaltevermögen, wenn etwas nicht läuft – eigenständiges und zuverlässiges Arbeiten, auch wenn dir niemand über die Schulter schaut Ohne Marketing-Filter Einen Senior Developer, der dich an die Hand nimmt, gibt es bei uns nicht. Ein Tutorial-Level auch nicht, das hier ist Open World. Du musst nicht alles wissen. Du solltest aber herausfinden können, wie du eine Aufgabe löst, und merken, wann du Hilfe brauchst. Dein Loot – fast komplett remote, von überall in Deutschland – einmal im Monat 2–3 Tage gemeinsam in Sinsheim, quasi der Raid vor Ort – direkter Draht zum Unternehmer statt Hierarchie-Dungeon – echte Softwareprojekte mit viel Spielraum – moderne KI-Tools und die Freiheit, Neues auszuprobieren – viel Verantwortung und eine langfristige Perspektive in der Unternehmensgruppe Roadmap Nach ein paar Monaten kennst du unsere Anwendungen, hast eigene Lösungen live gebracht und setzt kleinere Projekte allein um. 📍 Remote First – deutschlandweit | 2–3 Tage im Monat in Sinsheim

💰 36.000–42.000 € brutto/Jahr

💻 Vollzeit | Unbefristet

Die Immobilienbranche ist digital noch nicht da, wo sie sein könnte. Das ändern wir gerade mit unserem eigenen ERP, gebaut mit KI. In unserer Party ist nur noch der Slot „Entwickler“ frei.


Das ist deine Stelle, wenn …

– du an einem Bug dranbleibst, bis er wirklich gelöst ist,

– du mit Claude, Cursor & Co. nicht nur chattest, sondern damit baust,

– du Strategiespiele magst, weil man da erst denkt und dann klickt,

– dein GitHub mehr über dich verrät als dein Lebenslauf,

– du ein Problem lieber selbst knackst, als auf ein Ticket zu warten.

Studium abgeschlossen, abgebrochen oder nie angefangen? Ausbildung, Quereinstieg, Autodidakt? Ist uns egal. Wir schauen darauf, was du baust.

Wer wir sind

Wir sind die Zapf Unternehmensgruppe, ein Mittelständler mit Schwerpunkt Immobilien, Projektentwicklung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle.

Unter der ImmoSandbox GmbH entwickeln wir LeaseFox, ein ERP für die Verwaltung und Bewirtschaftung von Gewerbeimmobilien. Ideen für KI-Anwendungen, Automatisierungen und digitale Werkzeuge haben wir reichlich, sie entstehen bei uns schneller, als man „Feature-Request“ sagen kann. Was uns fehlt, ist jemand, der daraus saubere, stabile Software macht und dabei mitdenkt, wohin die Reise geht.

Deine Quests

– LeaseFox weiterbauen: neue Features, Bugs jagen, Architektur aufräumen.

– Ordnung ins kreative Chaos bringen: Du machst aus schnellen Ideen wartbaren Code, mit Struktur, Tests und Doku.

– direkter Draht zum Unternehmer statt Hierarchie-Dungeon

– echte Softwareprojekte mit viel Spielraum

Nach ein paar Monaten kennst du unsere Anwendungen, hast eigene Lösungen live gebracht und setzt kleinere Projekte allein um.

Langfristig wirst du unser technischer Mitdenker, der Ideen aufgreift und daraus funktionierende Software macht.

title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities. That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it. You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground. What you'll be doing Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc. Allocate investments across markets: Help optimize supply lever allocation, translating region and country budgets into the right mix of levers for each market. Test and learn in markets: Propose tests and actions within markets, in line with lever allocation, especially where we don't yet know the right answer or don't have enough data to rely on history. You'll work with local teams and analytics to shape the approach and turn what we learn into the next plan. Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets. Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches. Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements. Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions. Our humble expectations 3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment. Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems. Experience designing and interpreting tests or causal analyses, and good judgment about what you can and can't conclude from them in a marketplace setting. A systems view of supply: you consider trade-offs between levers and their knock-on effects on cost, courier experience, and customer experience. Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change. Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. Python, Cursor, and Claude Code are a plus. An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious, always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change. The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders, both local and global. A true culture champion who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. Based in Berlin or Helsinki, with the ability to work in a hybrid model from our Wolt office. Hiring Manager interview — a deeper conversation with the team manager about your experience, the team, and what this role involves day to day. Assignment — a practical task related to the role, giving you a chance to show how you approach real problems in this space. Final interview — a conversation with a senior stakeholder to round out the process. If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going! We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today! Please submit your up-to-date resume in English. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
