About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities.

That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.

You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc.
  • Allocate investments across markets: Help optimize supply lever allocation, translating region and country budgets into the right mix of levers for each market.
  • Test and learn in markets: Propose tests and actions within markets, in line with lever allocation, especially where we don't yet know the right answer or don't have enough data to rely on history. You'll work with local teams and analytics to shape the approach and turn what we learn into the next plan.
  • Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets.
  • Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches.
  • Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements.
  • Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions.

Our humble expectations

  • 3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.
  • Experience designing and interpreting tests or causal analyses, and good judgment about what you can and can't conclude from them in a marketplace setting.
  • A systems view of supply: you consider trade-offs between levers and their knock-on effects on cost, courier experience, and customer experience.
  • Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. Python, Cursor, and Claude Code are a plus.
  • An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious, always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change.
  • The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders, both local and global.
  • A true culture champion who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Based in Berlin or Helsinki, with the ability to work in a hybrid model from our Wolt office.

Next steps

What to expect from our hiring process:

  1. Talent Acquisition screen — an introductory conversation with our recruiter to learn more about your background and answer any initial questions about the role.
  2. Hiring Manager interview — a deeper conversation with the team manager about your experience, the team, and what this role involves day to day.
  3. Assignment — a practical task related to the role, giving you a chance to show how you approach real problems in this space.
  4. Final interview — a conversation with a senior stakeholder to round out the process.

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!

We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!

Please submit your up-to-date resume in English. 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Planning & Prioritisation: Own the social planning process and ensure the calendar is driven by clear business, brand, product and customer priorities. Make clear recommendations on where the team should focus time, resources and investment. Content Strategy: Set the strategic direction for the content we create, identifying the formats, stories, behaviours and cultural moments that will help TALA grow. Engineer Virality: Think beyond existing content formats to identify opportunities to create stop-and-look moments that capture attention and drive conversation. Challenge the team to think differently about how we execute ideas, finding unexpected, culturally relevant and creatively disruptive ways to make TALA stand out and content travel. Trend & Culture: Stay ahead of social, cultural and platform trends, identifying opportunities for TALA to participate in the conversation in a way that feels authentic to the brand and has the potential to drive meaningful reach and growth. Campaign Strategy: Partner with the Marketing team and Creative Director on campaign strategy, ensuring social plays a clear role in building awareness, excitement and cultural relevance. Develop channel strategies and rollout plans for key campaigns and launches. Insights & Analytics: Own the analysis of social performance, customer behaviour and competitor activity. Test & Learn: Develop a test-and-learn approach across social, identifying new formats, platforms, creators and ways of working. Test, learn and scale what works. Team Leadership: Lead, develop and inspire the social and content creation team, setting clear objectives, ways of working and standards. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce to ensure social is fully integrated into the wider marketing and commercial strategy. You will provide strategic direction while empowering the team to own day-to-day execution. Reporting: Own weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting against social KPIs, going beyond performance reporting to provide clear insights, recommendations and actions for the wider business. Key collaboration: Partner with the Head of Performance Marketing to create a boosting strategy Social Innovation: Keep TALA ahead of how social is evolving, from new platforms and formats to creators, communities and emerging behaviours, ensuring we continue to find new ways to grow our audience. Governance: Partner and align with the Creative Director on the visual representation of BAU, drops and campaign assets. Requirements You should: Have significant professional social media experience, ideally within a fast-moving fashion, beauty, lifestyle or consumer brand. Proven track record of working closely with a Creative team. Be highly collaborative with key stakeholders including Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce. Be able to demonstrate how you have grown a social presence, not just through content volume, but through a clear strategic approach. Have a proven track record of developing and delivering social strategies that have driven audience and brand growth. Have a deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok, with knowledge of Pinterest and LinkedIn. Be highly analytical and commercially minded, able to interpret data and turn it into clear strategic recommendations. Have a strong understanding of social culture, trends, formats and what makes content travel. Have experience developing social strategies, content frameworks, channel plans and campaign rollouts. Have experience managing and fostering development across a team, with the ability to set direction, inspire creativity and create a high-performing team culture. Be an excellent cross-functional collaborator and communicator, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and multiple teams. Be highly organised and an excellent project manager, able to bring clarity and structure to a fast-moving environment. Be comfortable working in a start-up environment: working lean, moving quickly and finding solutions with available resources. Be equally comfortable operating at a strategic level and getting into the detail when required. Be driven, ambitious and solution-oriented, with a genuine passion for finding new opportunities for growth. Have a strong understanding of the TALA brand and customer, and be excited about the opportunity to help shape the next stage of TALA’s growth. title: Head of Consulting (Sales & New Business) (80–100 %)
description: Schweizer Engineering für die Software von morgen. novu baut keine Lösungen von der Stange, sondern Individualsoftware, die zum Geschäft unserer Kunden passt. Wir definieren, entwickeln, betreiben und erweitern sie, alles im Haus und alles in der Schweiz, mit rund 50 Leuten in Zürich und Bern. novu gehört zur Union Group AG, einer Gruppe von Schweizer Agenturen für digitale Kommunikation. Software entsteht mit AI immer schneller. Umso mehr zählt, wer versteht, was Kunden wirklich brauchen, und wer ihr Vertrauen über Jahre gewinnt. Genau dafür bist du da: Als Head of Consulting verantwortest du das Neugeschäft von novu, führst unser Consulting-Team und prägst, wie wir beraten. Du berichtest an den CEO und arbeitest im Führungsteam eng mit CTO und Head of Operations zusammen. Was du bei uns machst Du verantwortest das Neugeschäft: Du baust eine belastbare Pipeline auf, gehst aktiv auf potenzielle Kunden zu, führst Pitches und schliesst Aufträge ab. Du kennst deine Zahlen und steuerst danach. Du betreust einige Schlüsselkunden selbst und berätst Geschäftsleitungen auf Augenhöhe. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team baust du bestehende Kundenbeziehungen aus und ziehst die Schwesteragenturen der Union Group AG bei, wo sie deinen Kunden weiterhelfen. Du führst das Consulting-Team: Du rekrutierst, gibst klares Feedback, führst die Standortgespräche und entwickelst die Beratungskompetenz jeder Person gezielt weiter. Du prägst, wie novu berät: Du setzt Standards für Angebote, Kundenführung und eine schlanke Projektführung und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden. Mit CTO und Head of Operations stimmst du Prioritäten und Kapazitäten ab, damit wir halten, was wir verkaufen. Gemeinsam mit dem CEO entwickelst du Angebot und Preismodelle weiter, gerade dort, wo AI verändert, wie Software entsteht und was Kunden dafür bezahlen. Den Einsatz von AI im Consulting treibst du selbst voran. Was du mitbringst Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung und Business Development rund um Software, Digitalprojekte oder IT-Dienstleistungen, idealerweise in einer Agentur. Du hast nachweislich Neugeschäft gewonnen und grössere Mandate selbst abgeschlossen. Führungserfahrung: Du hast ein Team geführt, idealerweise Consultants oder Projektleiterinnen und Projektleiter, und Menschen spürbar weiterentwickelt. Erfahrung in der Beratung von Geschäftsleitungen. Ein Netzwerk in der Schweizer Wirtschaft, auf das du aufbauen kannst, ist ein grosses Plus. Eigene Erfahrung in der Leitung von Software- oder Digitalprojekten. Du weisst, wo solche Projekte kippen und was sie kosten, und bist damit bei Kunden und im Team glaubwürdig. Unternehmerisches Denken: Du argumentierst mit Zahlen, kalkulierst sauber und verhandelst souverän. Du begeisterst dich für AI, probierst neue Werkzeuge selbst aus und kannst einschätzen, wie sie Beratung und Softwareentwicklung verändern. Dafür überführst du fehlende Mitarbeiterdaten aus dem Altsystem, prüfst und ergänzt Felder und schaffst eine saubere Datenbasis. Du erstellst praxistaugliche Vorlagen (z. B. Onboarding-Checklisten, Bestätigungen und Verträge) und konfigurierst Workflows, Reports, Berechtigungen sowie Abwesenheiten sinnvoll. Ziel: Personio ist zu 100 % nutzbar, spart spürbar Zeit im Tagesgeschäft und macht unsere HR-Prozesse transparent. Dabei behältst du die Qualität im Blick: Du prüfst Inhalte sorgfältig, achtest auf eine passende Tonalität und stellst sicher, dass Datenschutz und Vertraulichkeit jederzeit eingehalten werden. Ziel: KI unterstützt unser HR-Team sinnvoll im Arbeitsalltag und schafft mehr Zeit für die Themen, die wirklich zählen. Kommunikation & Employer Branding mitgestalten Zeig, wer wir als Arbeitgeber sind, und gestalte unsere Kommunikation aktiv mit. Du unterstützt sowohl die interne als auch die externe Kommunikation, entwickelst Inhalte für unseren Social-Media-Auftritt und unsere Karrierewebsite und erstellst ansprechende Grafiken und Materialien mit Tools wie Canva. Außerdem wirkst du bei internen wie externen Veranstaltungen mit und bringst deine Ideen ein, um unsere Arbeitgebermarke weiterzuentwickeln. Ziel: Unsere Kommunikation ist fair, transparent und sorgt dafür, dass wir intern wie extern weiterhin als attraktiver Arbeitgeber wahrgenommen werden. Qualifikation Deine Kompetenzen Background: Laufendes Studium im Bereich Personal/HR, Psychologie, Sozial- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder vergleichbar. Wichtig ist dein echtes Interesse an People-Themen und Prozessen. Persönlichkeit: Neugierig, teamorientiert, hilfsbereit und vertrauenswürdig. Du hörst zu, fragst nach und willst Kolleg:innenwirklich weiterhelfen. Diskretion ist für dich selbstverständlich. IT & Tools: Sicher im Umgang mit MS Office. Große Lust, Personio tief zu verstehen und hands-on zu konfigurieren. Affinität zu KI-Tools (z. B. „Mein GPT“) und Spaß daran, effiziente Prompts und kleine Automatisierungen zu bauen. Kommunikation : Klar in Wort und Schrift, sehr gutes Deutsch; gutes Englisch von Vorteil. Du formulierst adressatengerecht — von kurzen Mails und Anleitungen bis zu Karriereweb-Texten. Kreativität & Branding: Freude an Employer Branding und Content wie z. B. smarte Social-Media- Posts, Bilder/Slides mit Canva, authentische Firmeneinblicke auf unserer Karriereseite. Verfügbarkeit: D u hast 5-6 Monate Zeit um im Rahmen eines Hochschulpraktikums dein erlerntes Wissen einzusetzen Plus: Erste HR-Erfahrung (Praktika/Werkstudent), Organisation/Projektaufgaben oder Marketing/ Employer Branding. Benefits Was wir dir bieten Wirkung: Du trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass Projekte wie unser Energiepark Egling Realität werden – und damit zur Energiewende und zu einer enkeltauglichen Zukunft. Team & Kultur: Sei du selbst und wachse mit uns (Wissenstransfer). Du wirst von einem freundlichen und leistungsstarken Team aus Energieexpertinnen und Experten mit langjähriger Unternehmenszugehörigkeit herzlich empfangen, die ihr tiefes akademisches und praktisches Wissen gerne teilen. Arbeitsumgebung: Wir pflegen eine offene Arbeitskultur, in der Ideen und Initiativen gefördert werden. Wir bieten dir einen modernen Arbeitsplatz mit betriebsinterner Kantine und Barista Der Umwelt zuliebe stellen wir eine Fahrradinfrastruktur für alle Mitarbeiter und Mitarbeiterinnen zur Verfügung (Dusche, überdachte Stellplätze & Werkstatt). Benefits: Du bekommst Zugang zu unserem Firmen-Carsharing (Pkw, E-Bike, E-Autos), frisches Obst, Bezuschussung zum Essen in der Kantine, MVV-Zuschuss, Tischtennisplatte und Kicker. Die Poolfahrzeuge können auch privat genutzt werden. Teambuilding: Du kannst an regelmäßigen Firmenveranstaltungen wie Kick Off, Sommerfest, Grillen im Sommer, Wiesn, Eisstockschießen und Weihnachtsfeier teilnehmen. Standort: Unser Büro befindet sich in München und ist öffentlich gut erreichbar. Warum brauchen wir dich im Team? Unser Wachstum entsteht durch Menschen, die gerne hier arbeiten. Mit deiner Art hältst du diese Energie hoch: Du bis Teil eines fairen, effizienten und verlässlichen HR, damit Recruiting rund läuft, Onboarding wirklich ankommt und Prozesse einfach funktionieren. So bleibt unser Kununu‑Score von 4,6 kein Zufall. Vor allem schaffst du eines: mehr Zeit für das, was zählt — Menschen. Wenn du Freude daran hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Strukturen zu schaffen und mit Weitblick zu handeln, trägst du in dieser Rolle maßgeblich zum Erfolg unserer Mission – eine enkeltaugliche Welt hinterlassen – bei. title: (Senior) Supply Chain Consultant (m/w/d)
description:
About the role

Every RELEX implementation is a solution built from scratch for one customer: their processes, their data, their targets. (Senior) Supply Chain Consultants shape both sides of that build — the business processes and KPIs the customer will run on, and the configuration that makes them work in the system. Depending on your background you will lean more towards one side than the other. This is a heavily customer-facing role.

What you'll be doing

  • Understand how the customer really plans. Prepare, facilitate and document workshops to gather and specify business requirements, and run the data analysis that shows where the strengths and the gaps actually are.
  • Design the target picture — planning processes, roles and the KPIs the project is measured on — and guide customers towards RELEX best practice, including where their current way of working needs to change.
  • Build it. Configuration, business rules, workflows and reporting that deliver the design you just agreed, and that hold up in operation: nightly run performance, scalability and maintainability, not just functional correctness.
  • Make the value case tangible for customer leadership: define how forecast accuracy, availability, inventory and cost will be measured, and report honestly on where we stand.
  • Take it live. Coordinate User Acceptance Testing, resolve what testing surfaces, and upskill super users so the customer is proficient and self-sustaining after go-live.
  • Own adoption, not just delivery. A technically correct solution that nobody uses is not a successful project.
  • Document what you built — requirements, scope and configuration — so the project team, the customer and our Continuous Services colleagues can work with it after handover.
  • Work across disciplines: with Technical Consultants on the data model, interfaces and the customer's ERP landscape, and with Project Managers on scope, effort and timelines.

Within RELEX

  • Challenge and develop implementation best practice across industries (grocery, DIY, home goods, pharma, wholesale and more)
  • Share knowledge with the team as both a trainer and a participant, and support colleagues who are earlier in their journey
  • Work with our global teams on international projects and bring practices between regions
  • Use AI tooling actively in your daily work — we expect curiosity here and give you room to experiment

 

What we're looking for

  • Around 2+ years of relevant experience in supply chain or retail planning, demand and inventory planning, or in implementing / consulting on planning software. A degree in supply chain management, business, engineering, mathematics or computer science is a good foundation — but we care more about what you have actually done.
  • Structured thinking and comfort with ambiguity. Many customer requirements arrive without a ready-made answer. You break them down, work with data, and arrive at a defensible recommendation.
  • Communication that works across levels — from super users in a training room to senior stakeholders in a steering committee, including the conversations where the message is not what the customer hoped to hear.
  • Business-fluent German and English. Both are used daily.
  • Willingness to travel depending on the project phase.
  • Technical affinity: SQL, scripting, or an interest to pick these up

Additionally, for the Senior level:

  • Several years of consulting or implementation experience, including demonstrable ownership of a workstream or a smaller project end-to-end — scope, risk, timeline and completion, not just your own tasks
  • Reliable effort estimation for standard and custom requirements, supporting scoping and SOW discussions
  • Experience coaching and mentoring less experienced colleagues
  • Confidence in front of senior customer stakeholders, including steering committees
  • Hands-on experience with a supply chain planning system, either as a user or as an implementer
  • Experience defining and tracking KPIs or building a value case

Who we are

We’re bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing - and doing it together. 

  • Flexibility in how and where you work
  • Room to thrive in a fast-growing global company with a good market position
  • Practical benefits that support work, family, wellness, and everyday life
  • Annual leave
  • Diverse, inclusive, and supportive work culture
  • Work that meaningfully reduces waste and improves sustainability
  • Ownership, autonomy and flat hierarchies
  • Two paid volunteering days each year

We are a global community of different cultures, voices, and experiences. We celebrate what makes us unique and connect through what we share, in an authentic and safe environment. Together we shape the future, and each other. 

If you feel this is the opportunity you don’t want to miss, you can apply by sending your resume through the application form as soon as possible. Please note that we cannot process any applications through email.   

Apply today and be part of the future. Be RELEX!

title: ABM Operations Manager, AI & Automation
description:
About the role 

Our ABM team runs highly targeted programs for the accounts that matter most to RELEX. We want those programs to be even more personalized, more interactive, and faster to launch across channels, without adding manual effort for every new account. 

That's where you come in. You'll advise how the ABM team runs and develops five operational areas: paid media, landing page creation, content personalization, targeted direct mail, and analytics. You'll review how each area works today, then design and build the AI-based workflows, templates, and quality guardrails that let the team focus on account strategy, creativity and stakeholder alignment over manual work. 

What you'll do 

Across all five operational areas 

  • Map how each area works today, find where time and quality can be improved, and agree a prioritized automation roadmap with the Head of ABM
  • Build and maintain the AI workflows the ABM team uses day to day, with tools such as Claude, n8n, Folloze and HubSpot
  • Partner with Marketing Operations, who own our martech platforms, data, and integrations: build ABM workflows on top of the shared stack, follow its standards, and hand over anything that should become a cross-team capability
  • Agree brand and quality guardrails with Brand & Creative so AI-produced assets can go live with light review
  • Document every workflow and train the team so it runs without you 

Ad operations (LinkedIn, Influ2) 

  • Own the setup and execution model for ABM account and contact level campaigns
  • Build workflows and guardrails that cut the time spent on campaign setup
  • Build workflows that generate on-brand ad variants by account, segment, and buying group role
  • Run channel and tactic experiments to find the right mix of reach, engagement, and conversion activity
  • Close the data feedback loop, so account and contact level engagement flows back to the account team and into ABM planning automatically 

Landing page operations 

  • Build a template and component library the team can use to generate account and segment pages with AI
  • Set standards for personalization depth, and work with ABM designers on a tailored look and feel per account
  • Find opportunities to build deeper, more interactive experiences for prospects 

Content build operations 

  • Build and fine-tune workflows that turn existing RELEX content (research, customer stories, point of view pieces) into account-tailored assets such as one-pagers, guides, and sales follow-up material 

Direct mail operations 

  • Design a direct mail program framework that delivers personalized mailers at scale
  • Own the operating model behind them: vendor setup, address data quality, GDPR compliance, budget, and cost per account
  • Connect every send to a defined sales follow-up, and measure what it contributes 

Analytics and reporting 

  • Define how ABM programs are measured, together with the Head of ABM and Marketing Operations: account reach, engagement, buying group coverage, and pipeline contribution
  • Build and maintain reporting that shows what's working by account, channel, and tactic, so channel and budget decisions rest on evidence rather than assumption
  • Keep campaign data clean and comparable across platforms, including naming conventions, UTM standards, and campaign taxonomy
  • Measure the impact of the AI workflows themselves: time saved, cost per asset, and speed from brief to launch 

What we're looking for 

  • 4+ years in B2B ABM, demand generation, growth marketing, GTM engineering, or marketing operations
  • A working understanding of how B2B paid media runs, ideally on LinkedIn: campaign structure, account and contact list targeting, bidding and budget pacing, and which platform metrics you can and can’t trust
  • A proven track record of designing and shipping AI and automation workflows that other people use, with examples you can walk us through
  • Practical experience working with LLMs: prompt design, structured outputs, connecting models to business data and tools, and evaluating output quality
  • Hands-on experience building automations in n8n, Make, Zapier, Workato, or similar, including APIs, webhooks, JSON, and error handling
  • A process mindset: you can map a workflow, see where it breaks, and design a repeatable replacement
  • Good judgment on quality: you know when AI output is ready to be rolled out and when it isn't 

Nice to have 

  • Enough Python or JavaScript to write, read, and debug automation scripts and API calls
  • Experience with intent and engagement platforms such as 6sense, or contact-level advertising such as Influ2
  • Experience running direct mail or gifting programs in B2B
  • Working knowledge of SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (for example Power BI, Looker, or Tableau)
  • Background in global enterprise B2B software with long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles 

About RELEX 

RELEX Solutions creates cutting-edge supply chain and retail planning software. Within our platforms, we have the power and potential to increase adaptability, efficiency, and sustainability in the consumer goods and retail value chain. Our impact is tangible; from sustainability and eliminating waste to delighting customers and delivering great tailored tech solutions, we’re curious and passionate challenge-seekers creating the future of retail today.

We’re currently a global team of 2000+ employees working from offices in the US (Atlanta), UK, Germany, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Singapore, Australia, and our headquarters in Helsinki, Finland. We work in small teams where everyone’s input is valued. We’re passionate about what we do, we like putting our skills to the test, and we make sure we have fun during the process — because life is supposed to be fun.

RELEX Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform. 

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

title: Principal Radio Frequency Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts. Metrea specialises in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.

The Expeditionary Operations Lab, or EXOLAB, focuses on the rapid development, integration, evaluation and delivery of expeditionary capabilities within the Electromagnetic Warfare and Cyber domain. EXOLAB works across research and development, experimentation, prototyping, systems integration, trials and operational delivery. The team addresses complex customer problems by combining existing technologies, emerging capabilities and internally developed solutions into deployable systems. The lab operates across airborne, land, maritime and dismounted environments, with a strong emphasis on practical engineering, rapid learning and delivering systems that are operationally relevant, supportable and resilient. 

Position Summary

We are seeking a Principal RF Engineer to lead and support the research, design, development, integration and delivery of radio-frequency systems for expeditionary Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum operations and secure communications capabilities. 

The role will be responsible for the RF engineering aspects of prototype and operational systems, including RF architecture, receiver and transmitter chains, antenna systems, signal distribution, filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, interference management and system performance analysis. 

The Principal RF Engineer will operate as a senior technical authority within a multidisciplinary team comprising electrical, systems, mechanical, software, cyber and operational specialists. The role will support the full engineering lifecycle, from concept development and technology evaluation through detailed design, integration, verification, trials, deployment and through-life support. 

This is a practical, delivery-focused engineering role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between theoretical analysis, simulation, laboratory testing, prototype development, platform integration and field trials. 

The role will be based either in Lincoln or London, with a longer-term intent to transition the primary location to London if hired initially in Lincoln. 

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop and integrate RF systems for expeditionary Unmanned Systems control, Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum-monitoring and secure communications capabilities
  • Develop RF system architectures covering antennas, receivers, transmitters, amplifiers, filters, frequency conversion, switching and signal distribution
  • Conduct RF performance analysis, including gain, noise figure, sensitivity, dynamic range, linearity, link budgets and interference assessments
  • Support rapid R&D, prototyping and technology evaluation, translating operational requirements into practical and deployable RF solutions
  • Integrate commercial, government and internally developed RF equipment across airborne, vehicle-mounted, maritime, fixed-site and unmanned platforms
  • Plan and conduct RF testing, characterisation, fault diagnosis, verification and corrective engineering activity
  • Ensure RF designs consider electromagnetic compatibility, spectrum management, grounding, bonding, shielding, environmental protection and relevant standards
  • Work closely with electrical, mechanical, software, cyber, systems and operational teammates throughout the engineering lifecycle
  • Support UK and international trials, demonstrations, installations, commissioning and operational deployments
  • Provide RF technical leadership, design assurance and clear engineering recommendations to customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders

What You Bring

  • Degree in RF Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering or a closely related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
  • Minimum of seven years’ experience in RF systems design, development, integration, testing or delivery
  • Experience working with complex RF systems within defence, aerospace, telecommunications, Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, secure communications or a related sector
  • Experience with Software Defined Radios, digital RF architectures and the collection or analysis of IQ data
  • Experience designing, integrating or supporting RF systems for unmanned systems, including uncrewed aerial, ground or maritime platforms
  • Strong understanding of RF receiver and transmitter architectures, including amplifiers, filters, mixers, oscillators, switches and frequency-conversion stages 
  • Experience conducting cascade analysis, link-budget calculations and assessments of gain, noise figure, sensitivity, linearity and dynamic range
  • Practical experience with antenna systems, RF distribution, transmission lines, impedance matching, grounding, bonding and shielding
  • Strong RF test, measurement and fault-finding skills using equipment such as spectrum analysers, vector network analysers, signal generators, oscilloscopes and power meters
  • Experience using RF simulation, modelling, schematic-capture or system-analysis tools
  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams spanning electrical, mechanical, software, cyber, systems and operational disciplines
  • Ability to produce clear technical documentation, communicate engineering recommendations and travel regularly within the UK and internationally

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

  • Experience designing expeditionary, deployable, ruggedised or rapidly reconfigurable RF capabilities
  • Experience integrating RF systems onto airborne, vehicle-mounted, maritime, fixed-site or dismounted platforms
  • Understanding of antenna selection, placement, radiation patterns, platform effects and co-site interference
  • Experience with wideband receivers, transmit chains, power amplifiers, low-noise amplifiers, filters and RF switching networks
  • Experience conducting electromagnetic compatibility, electromagnetic environmental effects and radio-frequency interference assessments
  • Familiarity with relevant defence, aviation, maritime, spectrum-management or RF engineering standards
  • Experience supporting prototype builds, field trials, exercises, customer demonstrations or operational deployments
  • Knowledge of systems engineering, size, weight, power and cooling analysis, low-volume manufacturing, component obsolescence and through-life support

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance  
  • Subsidised gym membership / plans through Wellhub  
  • Electric car scheme  
  • Cycle to work scheme  
  • Salary sacrifice pension scheme  
  • Free lunch on office days  
  • Enhanced parental leave  
  • 30 days annual PTO plus bank holidays  

Work Authorization / Security Clearance

The successful candidate must have the right to work in the United Kingdom. 

The role will require the individual to hold, or be capable of obtaining and maintaining, an appropriate UK national-security clearance. Certain projects may impose additional nationality or security restrictions. 

AAP/EEO Statement

Metrea Mission Data Limited is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.  

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. This position is offered on a hybrid working basis with three days per week in the office as standard, based out of London or Lincoln.

Work Environment

The role will involve work across: 

  • Office and engineering-design environments 
  • Laboratories and workshops
  • Customer and supplier facilities
  • Vehicle, aircraft and maritime-platform integration environments
  • Outdoor test, trial and exercise locations
  • Operationally representative and potentially austere environments  

Appropriate training, procedures and personal protective equipment will be provided where required. 

The role is not exclusively desk-based. It may involve: 

  • Standing, walking, bending, kneeling and working in restricted equipment spaces
  • Handling tools, cables, connectors and test equipment
  • Installing or removing electrical and electronic equipment
  • Lifting and carrying equipment within appropriate manual-handling limits
  • Working around vehicles, aircraft, generators and other powered systems
  • Periods of outdoor work in varying environmental conditions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with additional needs to perform the essential functions.

Travel

15%

Our Firmware

At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. It enables groups to self-organize around hard problems, shift fluidly as priorities evolve, and operate with the trust, curiosity, and discipline required in a complex mission space. This foundation allows us to deliver elegant, effective solutions and uphold our purpose: protecting our precious inheritance.

title: Quantum Algorithms Researcher (Senior/Staff)
description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real. 

Job Summary:

PsiQuantum is seeking a Senior Quantum Algorithms Researcher to join the Quantum Algorithms team within our Applications Development department. This role offers the opportunity to help define how large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers will be applied to consequential real-world problems in chemistry, pharmaceuticals, and materials science.  

At PsiQuantum, we believe in the transformative potential of quantum computing to solve problems beyond the reach of classical computation. For the first quantum computers to be useful, we believe they must be fault tolerant. 

This conviction shapes our approach to applications research. Rather than developing algorithms for near-term or intermediate-scale devices, we focus on quantum algorithms designed for the fault-tolerant regime, where, specifically, the cost of a quantum algorithm is determined by its runtime on a fusion-based, fault-tolerant quantum computer built on silicon photonic hardware. 

In the Quantum Algorithms team, we adapt and develop quantum algorithms, scope and identify promising use cases, and analyze resource requirements. In your role, you will translate computational tasks into abstract specifications for quantum algorithms, analyze their asymptotic performance, and help define meaningful problem instances that lie beyond the practical reach of classical computation. You will also work closely with PsiQuantum’s Compilation team to develop explicit instantiations of these algorithms and understand their resource requirements on our architecture. 

We are particularly interested in candidates with deep expertise in quantum simulation. Relevant areas may include simulated time-evolution algorithms, quantum algorithms for estimating the energies of molecular or periodic systems, and methods for preparing candidate ground states of model Hamiltonians. More broadly, the successful candidate will bring substantial expertise in a specific subfield of quantum algorithms, together with the ability to connect fundamental algorithmic research to computationally and industrially relevant problems. 

In this position, you will be expected not only to conduct outstanding individual research but also to formulate and lead broader research programs that encompass the work of other researchers and collaborators. You will contribute to cross-team initiatives across PsiQuantum’s applications, architecture, and compilation efforts, helping to connect algorithm design with the practical requirements of fault-tolerant quantum computation. 

The role may also include external engagements. You will have the opportunity to lead projects with industrial and research partners, working with domain experts to identify important computational challenges, extract well-defined problem formulations, and map those problems to appropriate quantum algorithms. This requires the ability to communicate across disciplinary boundaries and to move fluently between real-world applications, mathematical abstractions, algorithmic complexity, and implementation-level resource analysis. 

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with scientific leadership, intellectual independence, and a strong collaborative mindset. They will be comfortable shaping open-ended research directions, evaluating the practical significance of algorithmic advances, and guiding projects from the initial identification of an application through to a concrete fault-tolerant quantum algorithm and resource estimate. 

Responsibilities:

  • Propose initiatives into research and development of quantum algorithms tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computers; act as primary contributor to research programs beyond the current state of the art in quantum algorithms design.
  • Work closely with external partners to instantiate, validate and optimize quantum algorithms for use cases across a variety of domains, such as life sciences, industry and sustainability.
  • Establish families of benchmarks and problem instances to validate post-classicality of quantum algorithms.
  • Guide both the simulation and analysis of resource requirements for fault tolerant implementation of quantum algorithms in photonic quantum computing.

Experience/Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of research experience (academia or industry) in the field of quantum computing, with focus on algorithms and applications.
  • A degree in Physics, Math or Computer Science or equivalent is required. PhD in Physics, Math or Computer Science, with a focus on quantum information theory or quantum computation will be preferred.
  • Experience with quantum algorithms and compiling in the regime of fault tolerant gates preferred .
  • Experience working with partners in academia or industry to analyze real-world quantum applications of interest preferred.
  • Proven team player with an ability to work effectively across departments, sites and time zones.
  • Ability to work independently and contribute to fast-moving start-up environment.
  • Experience programming in Python, C++ or similar languages.

PsiQuantum provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market. Your Mission As our Launch Manager, you’ll own the end-to-end delivery of our partner onboarding, from kick-off through go-live and post-launch activities, turning complex, regulated brokerage integrations into predictable, high-quality launches. Our partner universe is evolving: alongside our direct business with fintechs and neobanks, we’re building a combined offering with dwpbank, bringing a new wave of partners and increased cross-organization complexity. We’re therefore building a dedicated Launch Manager function to run these onboardings with clear ownership. In this setup, you’ll provide the coordination we’re building, driving the launch plan, steering stakeholders, and ensuring a clean handover to Partner Management once the partner is live. You’ll sit at the center of cross-functional execution, aligning Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Operations, and second-line functions (and, where relevant, dwpbank) to keep delivery on time, within scope, and operationally sound. In this role you will: Lead end-to-end partner launches by owning the onboarding plan, milestones, and delivery rhythm across Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Operations, and second-line functions — so partners go live faster and with fewer surprises. Drive alignment and decision-making between partnership leads, product counterparts, and executive sponsors — so scope, priorities, and trade-offs are clear and execution stays on track. Run cross-functional workstreams (e.g., API integration readiness, ops/process setup, compliance & controls, partner enablement) to reduce delivery risk and ensure high-quality outcomes in a regulated environment. Design and continuously improve an onboarding playbook (templates, checklists, risk log, status reporting, launch criteria) to standardize onboarding and scale partner delivery without scaling chaos. Manage complex/time-sensitive post-launch activities (feature expansions, new functionalities, operational changes) so existing partners can grow their offering without destabilizing day-to-day operations. You bring strong financial services domain expertise (brokerage knowledge is a plus) and can translate regulatory/operational constraints into actionable delivery plans. You are comfortable mixing methods ( waterfall, agile, hybrid ) and pragmatically using tools like onboarding plans, risk logs, and reporting to get the job done. You thrive in ambiguity and complexity, take ownership end-to-end, and can zoom out for the plan while still digging into the messy details needed to execute. Communicate exceptionally well in English and German (C1+) building trust quickly, leading tough conversations calmly, and keeping momentum across senior internal and external stakeholders. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. title: Copy of Clinical Implementation Manager (m/f/d)
description: Company overview Mindpeak is building cutting-edge AI technology to transform cancer diagnostics for the better. Our AI-powered software is already in clinical use across more than 25 countries, helping pathologists assess tumour tissue faster, more accurately, and more consistently. Every year, tens of thousands of cancer patients already benefit from quicker and more accurate diagnoses enabled by our technology. Our mission is to scale this impact worldwide and help make personalised, effective cancer treatment accessible to every patient no matter where they are. By combining state-of-the-art AI with real-world clinical impact, we're working toward a future where every cancer patient gets the best possible diagnosis and, ultimately, the best possible care. The role Laboratories are digitising fast, and demand for our diagnostic AI has outgrown the way we deliver it. Every new lab is a project with many moving parts: our software is connected to the lab's image management and information systems, our AI is calibrated and validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met. Each project brings together lab directors, pathologists and IT on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally. Usually several of these projects run at the same time and compete for the same people. As Clinical Implementation Manager you own the delivery of these projects, from signed contract to routine clinical use. You set the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, make the trade-offs when projects compete, and carry the go-live date. From day one you own around 10 lab customers in parallel, from smaller labs to important accounts, without needing someone to tell you what to do next. This is a senior delivery role. We are looking for someone who has done this before and can take ownership quickly, not someone who will learn project execution on the job. It is not a sales role and carries no sales target. What you'll own Delivery of our lab implementations Own each implementation end to end: plan, milestones, dependencies, risks and the committed go-live date. Run several implementations in parallel. Sequence them, decide what moves first when they compete for ML, engineering or customer time, and escalate only what you cannot resolve. Drive technical integration with the lab and its partners (IMS, LIS, scanners, network and security reviews), working directly with our engineers and the customer's IT. Direct the work of our product, ML, engineering and quality teams and of the customer's staff. Get firm commitments, follow them up, and don't accept "not possible right now" without a plan. Accompany the validation each lab runs before go-live. The lab's medical director designs the study; you make sure the setup works, our teams deliver what the validation depends on, and the lab has everything it needs to finish. Raise risks early, with options and a recommendation, rather than after a date slips. The customer relationship through go-live and beyond Be the lab's main operational contact: run the regular project calls, send the recaps, keep every open item owned and dated on both sides. After go-live, own support for your labs: monitor usage, resolve what you can, coordinate product and engineering on the rest, and close the loop. Bring structured customer feedback into product planning, and flag expansion opportunities to Sales. How we deliver Use and improve our delivery playbook, tracking and tooling so each implementation is faster and more predictable than the last. What success looks like after six months You run our small and mid-size lab implementations independently, with the Head of Diagnostic Products informed but no longer in the day-to-day. Several onboardings run in parallel to plan, with fewer surprises close to deadlines. Customers have one competent contact; our internal teams get clear, prioritised requests instead of ad-hoc escalations. You are taking over parts of our larger, more product-heavy accounts. Your profile At least 2–3 years delivering projects to external customers, with several clients in parallel and at least one project owned from kickoff to go-live: clinical or diagnostic software, digital pathology, laboratory or medical device rollout, health IT, or comparable B2B delivery. A track record of hitting committed dates in projects with dependencies you did not control. You can describe a project that went wrong and what you did about it. A degree in a life or natural science such as biology, medicine, chemistry or physics, or several years of work in a comparable scientific field. You speak credibly with pathologists and can judge whether a pragmatic shortcut still makes scientific sense. Strong stakeholder management and communication. You lead conversations with lab directors, pathologists and IT teams, get commitments from people you don't manage, and raise blockers early. You work credibly with developers: you understand how they work and can challenge their estimates. You don't need to code. Organised and self-driven: you keep many commitments on track without reminders, work in our delivery tools and help improve them, need no hand-holding, and know when "good enough" is the right call. Full professional proficiency in English. Based in Hamburg or willing to relocate, and working on-site with the team. Willing to travel up to 10% of your time: 3–4 trips a year of about a week each, mostly to US customers and scientific conferences. Comfortable with regular late-afternoon or early-evening calls to overlap with US customers. Nice to have German language skills; experience in pathology, diagnostics or laboratory environments. Experience delivering software into a regulated clinical setting or working within a quality management system. Experience setting up or improving delivery processes and tooling in a growing team. What Mindpeak offers A role with real ownership in a team that is building out its diagnostics delivery right now. The opportunity to build AI systems that power both clinical cancer diagnostics and data-driven drug development. An open, creative work environment with flat hierarchies and quick decision-making. An excellent leadership team that invests in continuous development. A centrally located Hamburg office with a beautiful view over the harbour. Application details Please apply via our website with your CV, references, salary expectations and earliest start date. Every new lab is a project with many moving parts: our software is connected to the lab's image management and information systems, our AI is calibrated and validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met. Each project brings together lab directors, pathologists and IT on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally. Usually several of these projects run at the same time and compete for the same people.

As Clinical Implementation Manager you own the delivery of these projects, from signed contract to routine clinical use. You set the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, make the trade-offs when projects compete, and carry the go-live date. From day one you own around 10 lab customers in parallel, from smaller labs to important accounts, without needing someone to tell you what to do next.

This is a senior delivery role. We are looking for someone who has done this before and can take ownership quickly, not someone who will learn project execution on the job. It is not a sales role and carries no sales target.

What you'll own

Delivery of our lab implementations

  • Own each implementation end to end: plan, milestones, dependencies, risks and the committed go-live date.

  • Run several implementations in parallel. Sequence them, decide what moves first when they compete for ML, engineering or customer time, and escalate only what you cannot resolve.

  • Drive technical integration with the lab and its partners (IMS, LIS, scanners, network and security reviews), working directly with our engineers and the customer's IT.

  • Direct the work of our product, ML, engineering and quality teams and of the customer's staff. Get firm commitments, follow them up, and don't accept "not possible right now" without a plan.

  • Accompany the validation each lab runs before go-live. The lab's medical director designs the study; you make sure the setup works, our teams deliver what the validation depends on, and the lab has everything it needs to finish.

  • Raise risks early, with options and a recommendation, rather than after a date slips.

The customer relationship through go-live and beyond

  • Be the lab's main operational contact: run the regular project calls, send the recaps, keep every open item owned and dated on both sides.

  • After go-live, own support for your labs: monitor usage, resolve what you can, coordinate product and engineering on the rest, and close the loop.

  • Bring structured customer feedback into product planning, and flag expansion opportunities to Sales.

How we deliver

  • Use and improve our delivery playbook, tracking and tooling so each implementation is faster and more predictable than the last.

What success looks like after six months

  • You run our small and mid-size lab implementations independently, with the Head of Diagnostic Products informed but no longer in the day-to-day.

  • Several onboardings run in parallel to plan, with fewer surprises close to deadlines.

  • Customers have one competent contact; our internal teams get clear, prioritised requests instead of ad-hoc escalations.

  • You are taking over parts of our larger, more product-heavy accounts.

Your profile

  • At least 2–3 years delivering projects to external customers, with several clients in parallel and at least one project owned from kickoff to go-live: clinical or diagnostic software, digital pathology, laboratory or medical device rollout, health IT, or comparable B2B delivery.

  • A track record of hitting committed dates in projects with dependencies you did not control. You can describe a project that went wrong and what you did about it.

  • A degree in a life or natural science such as biology, medicine, chemistry or physics, or several years of work in a comparable scientific field. You speak credibly with pathologists and can judge whether a pragmatic shortcut still makes scientific sense.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication. You lead conversations with lab directors, pathologists and IT teams, get commitments from people you don't manage, and raise blockers early. You work credibly with developers: you understand how they work and can challenge their estimates. You don't need to code.

  • Organised and self-driven: you keep many commitments on track without reminders, work in our delivery tools and help improve them, need no hand-holding, and know when "good enough" is the right call.

  • Full professional proficiency in English.

  • Based in Hamburg or willing to relocate, and working on-site with the team.

  • Willing to travel up to 10% of your time: 3–4 trips a year of about a week each, mostly to US customers and scientific conferences.

  • Comfortable with regular late-afternoon or early-evening calls to overlap with US customers.

Nice to have

  • German language skills; experience in pathology, diagnostics or laboratory environments.

  • Experience delivering software into a regulated clinical setting or working within a quality management system.

  • Experience setting up or improving delivery processes and tooling in a growing team.

What Mindpeak offers

  • A role with real ownership in a team that is building out its diagnostics delivery right now.

  • The opportunity to build AI systems that power both clinical cancer diagnostics and data-driven drug development.

  • An open, creative work environment with flat hierarchies and quick decision-making.

  • An excellent leadership team that invests in continuous development.

  • A centrally located Hamburg office with a beautiful view over the harbour.

description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. We are proud to partner with Europe's leading Fintechs and Financial Institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26, and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 330 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, BlackRock, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experiences. As Upvest enters the next stage of growth, we are looking for an exceptional sales leader for continental Europe. You will work directly with our Director of Growth Alexander Reichhardt owning the topics most critical to Upvest's expansion beyond its current home markets: About the role: Own the go-to-market for Europe's next investment markets We aim high at Upvest. Over the last years we have built one of Europe's most relevant B2B fintechs: an Investment API on top of a self-developed core banking engine, with full regulatory licences and investment operations included. Germany and the UK are proven, with more than 20 clients live and over 110 million trades processed in 2025. Our licences are passported across 20+ EEA countries, which means the infrastructure for the rest of Europe is already in place. From here we’re on a journey to enter market by market in Europe, starting with France, Spain, and Italy. This is your opportunity to turn our foundation into a flywheel for new markets. You will own the go-to-market for continental Europe end-to-end: defining which client segments we go after first, from fast-growing fintechs to established banks, building the target list and the pipeline behind it, and shaping the commercial case that wins against local incumbents and against the instinct of large banks to build it all themselves. Lead high-stakes sales and win complex deals with financial institutions Our clients include the most ambitious fintechs and the most demanding financial institutions in Europe. Winning their business requires enterprise commercial rigour, deep domain knowledge, and genuine client partnership. Deals run over many months, involve procurement, risk, compliance and IT, and are won on substance rather than volume. Since inception we have been delivering on such high touch deals with clearly defined sales journeys, strong materials, and a unique approach now amplified by AI. You will lead those deals personally before you lead them through others. That means owning the largest opportunities in your region yourself, from first conversation to signature, while bringing the discipline that makes the motion repeatable: rigorous qualification, value-based and consultative selling, predictable forecasting, and a clear view on where not to spend time. You use AI actively to increase your own coverage and later that of your team, and you feed what you learn from clients back into product, solutions, and marketing. Attract, develop and lead a best-in-class sales team in European fintech Building world-class financial infrastructure requires world-class people. At Upvest we put hiring excellence and people development front and centre. The Growth team today features talented, driven people coming from Europe's leading fintechs, financial institutions, and technology companies, with Sales working side by side with revenue ops, marketing, partnerships, and solutions engineering on shared targets. With inspiring yet pragmatic and hands-on leadership you will build the European sales team around you. You will set the bar for the talent you hire, ramp new Account Executives fast, set and steer their targets, and coach them through cycles that few people have run before. You will be measured on what your team closes as much as on what you close yourself, and you will keep carrying a quota personally for as long as this stage of the business asks for it. What you’ll do: Real ownership of a region: This is a defining hire for our European expansion. You own commercial success for your markets, with Alexander , our Co-Founder Til Rochow , and the rest of senior leadership as your close sparring partners and supporters. A product that gives you an unfair advantage: Our Investment API is genuinely differentiated, a full-stack B2B investment infrastructure crafted with the best product principles and most modern tech stack in the industry. It is live, regulated by BaFin and the FCA, and proven at scale with clients such as DKB, Revolut, N26, and Raisin. A team that takes the work seriously: Upvest's Growth team, and the company around it, is one of a kind when it comes to combining impactful work with a collaborative and fun culture. You will have dedicated revenue ops, solutions engineering, marketing, and partnerships colleagues working with you on your deals, and strong practices around feedback, psychological safety, and team health. The complexity and richness of financial infrastructure: Working at the intersection of API-first SaaS and regulated financial services, with clients ranging from hypergrowth fintechs to global banks, is one of the most strategic and commercially interesting places to be. Every client relationship and every deal teaches you something new. If you are intellectually curious about how financial markets and products are being rebuilt from the ground up, this is the role for you. Flexibility with a European footprint: We are a Berlin- and London-headquartered company with a growing presence across Europe. We are equally open to candidates based in one of Europe's financial hubs, in particular Paris, Madrid, and Milan, who are willing to spend meaningful time in Berlin. What matters most is the quality of your leadership and the results you deliver. What you bring: 5+ years in senior sales roles, including at least two years leading a team, within high-growth B2B technology and financial services. You have sold API-based enterprise SaaS into fintechs, banks, brokers or wealth managers, and you know financial infrastructure such as core-banking or securities processing. A proven track record of closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions , and of building the foundations that make doing so repeatable. You have taken a sales team from first foundations to early scale, with a proven track-record of exceeding ambitious revenue targets Genuine European reach: You have sold across several European countries, with direct experience in at least one of France, Spain or Italy, a strong network in the world of banking and finance A modern approach to sales: customer-centric, value-based, data-driven, and AI-enabled. You have strong views on what great looks like, from qualification frameworks to CRM hygiene to how account plans and collaboration roadmaps have the highest impact and are enabled by and enhanced with AI, and you turn those views into standards the team works to. Hands-on ownership with strategic foresight: You operate practically, think in second-order effects to get complex deals across the line, and you are genuinely comfortable carrying quota yourself at this stage rather than only managing others who do. Outstanding people leadership: You hire exceptional people, develop them continuously, and create a non-hierarchical, inclusive and respectful environment where the best talent chooses to stay and grow. You will set the bar for the talent you hire, ramp new Account Executives fast, set and steer their targets, and coach them through cycles that few people have run before.
